mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.store_id, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.created_by, f.updated_by, f.use_yn, s.name, s.description, s.category, s.phone, s.address, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.min_order_amount, s.delivery_fee, s.delivery_time, s.status, s.image_url, s.business_number, s.is_featured FROM tb_favorites f INNER JOIN tb_store s ON f.store_id = s.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.use_yn = 'Y' AND s.status != 'CLOSED' ORDER BY f.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_favorites ( user_id, store_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, use_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{storeId}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy}, 'Y' )
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.user_id, f.store_id, f.created_at, f.updated_at, f.created_by, f.updated_by, f.use_yn, s.name, s.description, s.category, s.phone, s.address, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.min_order_amount, s.delivery_fee, s.delivery_time, s.status, s.image_url, s.business_number, s.is_featured FROM tb_favorites f INNER JOIN tb_store s ON f.store_id = s.id WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.store_id = #{storeId} AND f.use_yn = 'Y'
